title: Operators
description:
Complete the methods:

```java
static boolean isLeapYear(int year)         // divisible by 4, except centuries, except every 400 years
static String clock(int minutes)            // minutes after midnight as "h:mm": 125 is "2:05"
static int coins(int cents, int coin)       // how many coins of that size fit into cents
static boolean canVote(int age, boolean isCitizen, boolean isRegistered)   // 18 or over, citizen and registered
```

`clock` wraps around the day: 1440 is `"0:00"` again, and negative minutes count back from midnight (`-30` is `"23:30"`).
hints: `-30 % 1440` is `-30` in Java. `Math.floorMod(-30, 1440)` is `1410`, always from 0 to 1439.
